dimensions.assessment: Affects registered nurses, licensed practical nurses, and licensed vocational nurses across a wide range of Medicare service providers including hospitals, clinics, and home health agencies.
dimensions.evidence: The term 'nurse' means a registered nurse, a licensed practical nurse, or a licensed vocational nurse.

dimensions.assessment: Substantially alters working conditions and shift limits for nurses by prohibiting mandatory overtime past specified hours and protecting nurses who refuse or report violations.
dimensions.evidence: a provider of services shall not directly or indirectly, require a nurse to work--in excess of--a previously scheduled work shift... 48 hours in any workweek... or 12 consecutive hours

dimensions.assessment: Permits the Secretary to impose civil money penalties of up to $10,000 for each knowing violation by a provider of services.
dimensions.evidence: The Secretary may impose a civil money penalty of not more than $10,000 for each knowing violation of the provisions of this subsection committed by a provider of services.

dimensions.assessment: Amends the Social Security Act to add Medicare provider agreement requirements, mandates federal studies by AHRQ and OMB, and establishes administrative complaint procedures.
dimensions.evidence: Section 1866 of the Social Security Act (42 U.S.C. 1395cc) is amended... to comply with the requirements of subsection (l)

dimensions.assessment: Permanent statutory requirements taking effect one year after enactment, backed by ongoing federal oversight and reporting.
dimensions.evidence: The amendments made by this section shall take effect 1 year after the date of enactment of this Act.

missing_information: Total aggregate economic cost to healthcare providers for compliance and staffing adjustments
importance_detail.rationale: The bill conditions Medicare provider participation on strict limitations regarding mandatory nurse overtime, adds whistleblower protections, requires written policies and schedule postings, and authorizes civil money penalties up to $10,000 per knowing violation.
